verdict.rationale: The Patents group page documents contentious work: UK Supreme Court cases, FRAND/SEP litigation, UPC proceedings and pan-European litigation strategy. Nothing in the pack shows patent drafting, filing or prosecution, or portfolio-building strategy. Trade mark and design filing programmes cover a different IP right and do not transfer to this patent prosecution story.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages
